test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which programme was launched by the Union Government as a flagship programme to fulfil the main objectives of effective abatement of pollution, conservation and rejuvenation of River Ganga?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Namami Gange Programme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Namami Gange Program** is an integrated conservation mission that the **Union Government approved in June 2014 as a "Flagship Program"** with a financial allocation of Rs. 20,000 Crore to achieve **the twin goals of effective pollution reduction and conservation and revitalization of the national River Ganga.**
 
• A three-tier project monitoring mechanism has been developed for the Namami Gange Program, consisting of; ​
 
 
• high-level task committee supported nationally by NMCG and led by the Cabinet Secretary.
 
• A state-level committee led by the **Chief Secretary** with assistance from **SPMG**
 
• **District Magistrate-led committee at the district level.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important aspects of the program "Namami Gange"
 
 
• The 2014-2015 **budget** allocated more than** Rs. 20,000 crores **for the following five years.
 
• The project's scope includes **12 rivers, 47 municipalities, and 8 states.**
 
• By 2022, all **1,632-gram panchayats along the Ganges river** would be free of open defecation.
 
• For this initiative, the Environment, Urban Development, Shipping, Tourism, and Rural Development Ministries are collaborating with the nodal Water Resources Ministry.
 
• The involvement of those who live along the river's banks in this initiative will be a top priority.
 
• States, urban local bodies, and **Panchayati Raj institutions **will be involved in this project under the auspices of the **National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) and State Program Management Groups (SPMGs).**
